purpose: A real static Closure created in an inherited static method returns static::protected Generator. The factory Closure owns a captured Token that retires before first body entry, while lexical Base and called Leaf remain distinct.
source:
<?php
class Token78A {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Base78A {
    protected static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base78A'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf78A'), '|';
        yield 78;
        return 79;
    }
    public static function make($token) {
        echo 'MAKE|';
        return static function () use ($token) {
            echo 'CALL|';
            return static::body();
        };
    }
}
class Leaf78A extends Base78A {}
$token = new Token78A();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$factory = Leaf78A::make($token);
unset($token);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'RETURN|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 79), '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';

    protected function body() {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', (int) ($this === $weak->get()), '|',
             (int) (__CLASS__ === 'Base78B'), '|',
             (int) (static::class === 'Leaf78B'), '|';
        try {
            yield 78;
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }

class Leaf78B extends Base78B {}
$maker = new Leaf78B();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$template = function () { echo 'CALL|'; return self::body(); };
$bound = $template->bindTo($maker, Base78B::class);
unset($template);
$g = $bound();
unset($bound, $maker);
echo 'KEPT|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($g->current() === 78), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';

purpose: A rebound real Closure factory preserves effective lexical Mid/called Leaf and exact This after its own allocation retires; a same-template sibling owns the final captured Token until it retires before Generator resumption. The real Generator frame owns This through fresh SEND and supplied Fiber abort, while its reference cache alone retains Payload after closed current becomes NULL.

<?php
class Capture78 {}
class Payload78 { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Base78 {
    protected function &body(&$item) {
        global $weakMaker, $weakPayload;
        echo 'BODY|', (int)(__CLASS__ === 'Base78'), '|',
            (int)(static::class === 'Leaf78'), '|', (int)($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
        try {
            Fiber::suspend('fresh78');
            $received = yield $item;
            Fiber::suspend('cached78');
            echo 'BAD-BODY|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', (int)($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|',
                (int)($received === 13), '|', (int)($item === $weakPayload->get()), '|';
        }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Mid78 extends Base78 {
    protected function &body(&$item) { echo 'BAD-MID|'; yield $item; }
}
class Leaf78 extends Mid78 {}
function Run78() {
    global $g, $stop, $weakMaker, $weakPayload;
    try { echo 'CALL|'; $g->send(13); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (Exception $e) {
        echo 'OUT|', (int)($e === $stop), '|', (int)($e->getPrevious() === null), '|',
            (int)($weakMaker->get() === null), '|', (int)($weakPayload->get() instanceof Payload78), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber78';
}
$item = new Payload78();
$old =& $item;
$weakPayload = WeakReference::create($item);
$capture = new Capture78();
$weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture);
$base = function (&$argument) use ($capture) {
    global $weakMaker;
    echo 'FACTORY|', (int)(get_called_class() === 'Leaf78'), '|',
        (int)($this === $weakMaker->get()), '|';
    return parent::body($argument);
};
$one = new Leaf78();
$two = new Leaf78();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($one);
$weakOther = WeakReference::create($two);
$first = $base->bindTo($one, 'Mid78');
$second = $base->bindTo($two, 'Mid78');
$weakFactory = WeakReference::create($first);
$g = $first($item);
unset($capture, $base, $first, $one, $two, $item);
$item = 9;
echo 'FRESH|', (int)($weakFactory->get() === null), '|',
    (int)($weakMaker->get() instanceof Leaf78), '|', (int)($weakCapture->get() instanceof Capture78), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run78');
echo 'START|', (int)($f->start() === 'fresh78'), '|';
echo 'DROP-SIB|';
unset($second);
echo (int)($weakOther->get() === null), '|', (int)($weakCapture->get() === null), '|';
unset($old);
echo 'RESUME|', (int)($f->resume() === 'cached78'), '|';
echo 'CACHE|', (int)($g->current() === $weakPayload->get()), '|', (int)($item === 9), '|';
$stop = new Exception('stop78');
echo 'ABORT|';
$f->throw($stop);
echo 'CLOSED|', (int)($g->current() === null), '|',
    (int)($weakPayload->get() instanceof Payload78), '|', (int)($f->getReturn() === 'fiber78'), '|';
unset($g);
echo 'DROP|', (int)($weakPayload->get() === null), '|E';
